name: 战略（分析/定位/实施）框架

map.按 1–10 分对「行业吸引力」（市场增速、市场规模、利润率，越高越好）与「业务: Score "industry attractiveness" (market growth, market size, profit margin - higher is better) and "business competitiveness" (share, brand, technology, channel) on a 1-10 scale, with competitive intensity scored in reverse. Normalize each dimension to 0-100%, place the result in the corresponding cell of the GE nine-box matrix, and give action advice such as invest / select / harvest / divest along with an implementation checklist.
map.行业吸引力维度（各 1–10 分，竞争强度数值越大表示越激烈）: Industry attractiveness dimensions (1-10 each; a higher competitive-intensity value means fiercer competition)
map.把近 12 个月营收按月贴入，看均值、: Paste the last 12 months of revenue by month to see the mean,
map.与极差，判断增长是稳步抬升还是靠单月冲高。: and the range, judging whether growth climbs steadily or relies on a single strong month.
map.战略研讨会前汇总各业务线关键指标（客单价、复购率），用离散程度看哪条线最难预测。: Before a strategy workshop, gather key metrics for each business line (average order value, repurchase rate) and use dispersion to see which line is hardest to forecast.
map.对标同行公开数据时，用同一口径的均值与: When benchmarking against peers' public data, use the mean with the same definition and
map.做横向比较，避免只看峰值造成定位偏差。: for a like-for-like comparison, avoiding positioning bias from looking only at peaks.
map.12 个月营收的稳定性判断: Judging the stability of 12 months of revenue
map.贴入 12 个月营收得到均值 820 万、中位数 795 万、标准差 96 万；: Pasting 12 months of revenue gives a mean of 8.2M, a median of 7.95M and a standard deviation of 0.96M; a mean above the median means a few months run high, so growth is driven by occasional large orders rather than a steady trend, and the resource baseline should be set by the median rather than the mean.
map.两条业务线波动对比: Comparing volatility of two business lines
map.A 线标准差 32、B 线标准差 118，量级相近但 B 线波动接近 A 线的: Line A has a standard deviation of 32 and line B of 118; they are similar in scale but B fluctuates nearly 4 times as much as A; if the strategic goal is stable cash flow, cut fixed investment in B first and switch it to a variable-cost structure.
map.输入营收还是利润都可以吗？: Can I use revenue or profit either way?
map.页面只做数值统计、不区分科目，需要你自行保证同一批数据同口径同单位；混贴不同科目: The page only runs numeric statistics and does not distinguish accounts, so you must ensure a single batch uses the same definition and unit; mixing accounts or units (ten-thousands and units) makes the mean and standard deviation meaningless.
map.标准差大一定是坏事吗？: Is a large standard deviation always bad?
map.取决于指标性质：营收、现金流这类越大越好的指标波动大意味着可预测性差；试错型投入: It depends on the metric: for higher-is-better metrics such as revenue and cash flow, high volatility means poor predictability; for experimental spending, volatility may come from deliberate diversification, so read it together with the business goal.
map.为什么均值会高于中位数？: Why can the mean be higher than the median?
map.说明分布右偏，即存在少数远高于多数的值；此时中位数更贴近典型水平，均值更适合做总: It means a right-skewed distribution, with a few values far above the rest; the median is then closer to the typical level and the mean is better for total estimates, so look at both.
map.围绕战略议题提供结构化分析框架（SWOT/竞争定位/实施路径），把模糊讨论拆成可: Provides a structured analysis framework for strategic topics (SWOT / competitive positioning / implementation path), breaking vague discussion into actionable dimensions.
